typed_links.link: In dialogue-dense narrative the named-speaker formula is a turn marker, not a unit reset: 2:20 carries vattomer Naomi twice inside one exchange, and 1:8/1:11 pattern identically; unit seams require relocation or participant change alongside the formula.

A bare disjunctive clause seams only when it introduces a new participant ahead of its own scene and/or carries a narrator-time deictic: 1:2 fails both (absorbed), 2:1 passes the first (medium_low), 4:7 passes both (high). One stated principle governs all three sites.

The toledot coda stays one register row: an unvaried holid chain with no per-entry differentiation, set off from the birth-naming scene by the formal heading with the book's single pe as weak corroboration.
